results.note: 505(b)(2) IV nanoparticle reformulation of approved nimodipine. ODD.
results.eligibility:
Inclusion:
Adults age 18 or older
Confirmed aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage
Randomization within 96 hours of bleed onset
WFNS grade I-IV
Modified Fisher score 1-4
Able to receive full 21-day course of nimodipine
Exclusion:
Severe cardiac disease
Hypotension at screening
Hypersensitivity to nimodipine
Pregnancy
Prior CYP3A inducer use

results.note: PLK1 inhibitor + FOLFIRI + bevacizumab. Jan 2026 interim: 72.2% ORR at 30mg vs 43% SOC.
results.eligibility:
Inclusion:
Age 18 or older with histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma
KRAS mutation (any variant)
No prior therapy for metastatic disease
ECOG performance status 0-1
Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1
Adequate organ function
Exclusion:
Prior PLK1 inhibitor exposure
Active CNS metastases
Grade 3 or higher peripheral neuropathy
Uncontrolled hypertension
Pregnancy or breastfeeding
